source: English translation of Meridiq questionary 16414 (Hälsodeklaration | Hair TP Clinic). Not Meridiq 14865 archive form.

intro.title: Before your consultation
intro.body: To provide safe and accurate advice before your consultation, we ask you to answer a few questions about your health. This information helps us assess what is suitable for you.
intro.note: Used for consultations for PRP (hair & skin), Microneedling PRF and hair transplants.

other.title: Other
other.contact: How did you hear about Hair TP Clinic?

gdpr.title: Personal data & communications
gdpr.storage: I consent to my information being stored in Hair TP Clinic's systems in accordance with the Patient Data Act and GDPR.
gdpr.email: I consent to receiving email communications from Hair TP Clinic.

questions.label: Do you use tobacco or nicotine products (e.g. cigarettes, snus, vape)?
Do you have or have you previously had heart or cardiovascular disease (e.g. heart attack, angina, arrhythmia)? If yes, specify what.
Have you been diagnosed with high blood pressure (hypertension)?
Do you have any other condition we should know about (e.g. diabetes, coagulation disorder, immunological disease)? If yes, specify what.
Do you have any blood-borne disease? If yes, please specify below:
Is there anything else we should know about your health? If yes, please describe.
Do you take any medications (regularly or as needed)? If yes, please specify the medication name, strength (mg/ml) and dosage below.
Do you take blood-thinning medication? If yes, please specify the medication name, strength (mg/ml) and dosage below.
Do you take Omega 3, fish oil or other supplements that affect bleeding?
Are you allergic or hypersensitive to any medication (including local anaesthetic or antibiotics)? If yes, specify which and any reaction.
Would you like us to focus on anything in particular during the consultation (e.g. hair, skin, or both)? If yes, please describe briefly.
